verdict.rationale: Make's own docs show scenarios that run without user intervention: webhooks trigger execution from external events, and scenarios can be scheduled so queued work is processed every time the schedule criteria are met. This is a recurring schedule, not a one-off run. Agentic automation is also documented via the Make AI Agents app and its AI Agents API. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of schedule options (intervals, cron-like control), explicit description of background or unattended execution behaviour, the AI Agents API is still in open beta, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
